affordance_in_statement: To compare two configurations, compare the mode assigned to access point 1, then access point 2, and so on up to n. The first position where they differ determines which configuration is smaller.
removal_suggestion: Do not present lexicographic minimality as an invitation to construct the answer greedily in access-point order. Describe it as a global post-selection rule: among all complete valid configurations, select the minimum printed vector only after feasibility has been established. Also explicitly state that adversarial instances defeat exhaustive fixed-order enumeration.
